issues.title: Inconsistent spacing around function arguments
issues.description: The code contains inconsistent spacing around commas in function arguments that violates the project's rustfmt configuration. Specifically, missing space after comma and extra spaces after comma in method calls.
issues.rule_name: Rust Code Must Be Formatted According to Project rustfmt Configuration

issues.title: Cookie deletion incorrectly calls SetCookie instead of DeleteCookie
issues.description: The delete_cookie function is sending a WebviewMessage::SetCookie message instead of WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie. This causes the cookie to be set/updated instead of being deleted when the delete_cookie API is called. Any code attempting to delete cookies will fail to remove them, and may inadvertently persist or update cookies that should be removed. This breaks the entire cookie deletion functionality and creates a security concern where sensitive cookies cannot be properly removed.

issues.title: Window size applied before position in window_features causing incorrect window placement
issues.description: In the window_features method, the size configuration is now applied before the position configuration, reversing the original order. This can lead to incorrect window positioning behavior because some window managers calculate the final window position based on the current window size. When the size is set after the position, the position may be recalculated or adjusted incorrectly. This particularly affects windows opened through the on_new_window handler when both size and position are specified in NewWindowFeatures.

issues.title: Changed window naming pattern breaks window label consistency
issues.description: The window label format for dynamically created windows has been changed from "new-{number}" to "new-window-{number}". This breaks the established naming convention and will cause any code that attempts to retrieve or manipulate these windows using the expected label format to fail. For example, code trying to access "new-0" or "new-1" will not find the windows, as they are now named "new-window-0" and "new-window-1". This affects window management, event handling, and any window lookup operations that depend on the label pattern.

issues.title: Public re-export lacks rustdoc documentation
issues.description: A new public API item (`pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie;`) was added without a `///` documentation comment. Line comments (`// ...`) do not satisfy the rule requiring rustdoc comments for public APIs.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
// Remove this re-export in v3
pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie;
issues.rule_name: Public APIs Must Include Documentation Comments

issues.title: New code uses unwrap() on fallible operations
issues.description: Added code introduces multiple `unwrap()` calls on fallible operations (`parse().unwrap()`, `set_title(...).unwrap()`, and `build().unwrap()`), which violates the rule prohibiting panics/unwraps in favor of explicit error handling via `Result`.
issues.rule_name: Functions Should Return Result Types for Fallible Operations

issues.title: User-facing API change without a .changes entry
issues.description: This PR changes a user-facing API (renaming/replacing `with_window_features` with `window_features` and updating docs/examples accordingly) but does not add any markdown change file under `.changes/` in the diff, violating the requirement to include a covector change file for releasable functionality/API changes.
issues.rule_name: Changes Requiring a Version Bump Must Include a Change File

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14020 - fix: a few regressions from previous PRs

structured_output.summary:
This PR bundles three small regression fixes: it drops a redundant clone in the wry cookie dispatch path, restores the `tauri::webview::Cookie` re-export from `tauri_runtime`, and moves the API example's `on_new_window` handler behind a desktop-only cfg. It also renames `WebviewWindowBuilder::with_window_features` to `window_features` and updates the doc examples to match.

The cookie fix is broken. `WryWebviewDispatcher::delete_cookie` was changed from sending `WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie` to `WebviewMessage::SetCookie`, so deleting a cookie now sets it instead. Nothing in the diff tests this path, so the regression would ship silently. The re-export and example changes are reasonable. The public rename has no deprecation alias, and the edited `window_features` body has spacing that would fail rustfmt.
structured_output.verdictRationale: `delete_cookie` now performs a write, which is a correctness regression in the area this PR claims to fix. That must be reverted before merge. The public rename of `with_window_features` without an alias is a breaking change for downstream callers and needs an explicit decision.

architecture.overview:
Public webview cookie and window-builder APIs in `crates/tauri/src/webview/` forward into the `tauri_runtime::WebviewDispatch` trait. In `tauri-runtime-wry`, `WryWebviewDispatcher` converts each call into a `WebviewMessage` and sends it to the event loop, which applies it to the native webview. `set_cookie` and `delete_cookie` are separate operations that map to separate `SetCookie` and `DeleteCookie` message variants.

This PR changes three things. It fixes the dispatcher so `delete_cookie` should send `DeleteCookie`, but the diff instead routes it to `SetCookie`. It re-exports `tauri_runtime::Cookie` at `tauri::webview::Cookie`. It renames the builder helper `with_window_features` to `window_features`, which is used by the `on_new_window` example.
steps: Entry point: `Webview::set_cookie` / `delete_cookie` in `crates/tauri/src/webview/mod.rs` call the runtime dispatcher.

`WryWebviewDispatcher` in `crates/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs` (around lines 1700-1720) builds a `WebviewMessage` and sends it to the event loop. This PR changes the `delete_cookie` variant, which is the bug.
The public surface gains `pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie` at `crates/tauri/src/webview/mod.rs`, so downstream code can name the type through `tauri::webview::Cookie` again.

`WebviewWindowBuilder::window_features` in `crates/tauri/src/webview/webview_window.rs` (around line 1315) replaces `with_window_features`. It applies size, position, and platform-specific opener settings to a `NewWindowFeatures` value.
The API example in `examples/api/src-tauri/src/lib.rs` now registers `on_new_window` only under `#[cfg(all(desktop, not(test)))]` and uses the renamed builder method.

findings.title: delete_cookie sends SetCookie, so deleting a cookie writes it instead
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs`, the `delete_cookie` method of `WryWebviewDispatcher` (around line 1718) sends `WebviewMessage::SetCookie`. It should send `WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie`, matching the `WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie` variant handled in the event loop around line 3737. Keep the redundant-clone removal (`cookie.into_owned()` without `.clone()`). Also add a test or a manual check that `delete_cookie` removes a cookie and does not set it.

findings.title: Renaming with_window_features to window_features is a breaking API change with no alias
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/webview/webview_window.rs`, the method `window_features` (around line 1315) replaces the public `with_window_features`. Either restore `with_window_features` as a `#[deprecated]` wrapper that calls `window_features`, or confirm that `with_window_features` was never in a released version and note that in the PR description. Keep the doc examples in `crates/tauri/src/webview/mod.rs` and `webview_window.rs` consistent with whichever name is kept.

findings.title: Formatting in window_features will fail rustfmt
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri/src/webview/webview_window.rs`, fix the spacing in `window_features` (around lines 1316-1321) so it matches rustfmt output: `inner_size(size.width, size.height)` and `position(position.x, position.y)`. Run `cargo fmt`. If the order of the `size` and `position` calls was changed on purpose, state the reason in the PR description; otherwise restore the original order.

findings.title: Unrelated label change in the API example
findings.body:
The example window label changed from `new-{number}` to `new-window-{number}`. That isn't one of the three regressions in the PR description, so it's an unlisted behavior change. Anything that targets the window by the old label will stop matching. It is probably harmless in an example app, but it should be called out or reverted.

::diff{file="examples/api/src-tauri/src/lib.rs" lines="84-92"}
findings.fixPrompt: In `examples/api/src-tauri/src/lib.rs`, the window label was changed from `format!("new-{number}")` to `format!("new-window-{number}")` (around line 88). Revert it to the original label unless the rename is needed, and mention it in the PR description if it is kept.

findings.title: Desktop-only gating of on_new_window in the API example
findings.body:
Moving the `on_new_window` registration into the `#[cfg(all(desktop, not(test)))]` block, along with the `AtomicUsize` counter and the cloned `AppHandle`, keeps the mobile build from referencing a method that isn't supported there. The state is now created only where it is used, which is cleaner than creating it unconditionally.

The `test` exclusion also matches the existing gating around the window title and menu, so the example stays consistent.

findings.title: Re-export of tauri_runtime::Cookie restores the public path
findings.body:
Replacing the direct `use cookie::Cookie` import with `pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie` keeps `Webview::set_cookie` and related signatures on the same type that the runtime uses. The comment marks it for removal in v3, which makes the intent clear for future maintainers.

::diff{file="crates/tauri/src/webview/mod.rs" lines="20-25"}
